decisions.reason: Gas tariff comparison runs on the same daily updated market data as the core offer, so it is cheap to keep and still useful for platform expansion.
The regional electricity tariff calculator has its own page, sits next to the core offer and serves steady supplier demand.
The energy tariff calculator line overlaps with C and is only mentioned on the website, but folding it into the platform is more likely than withdrawing it.
The area definition tool underpins the remaining location-based products, although the withdrawal of A slightly weakens its role.
Site-specific tariff comparison stays close to the established offer and is cheap to maintain on shared data, despite its low visibility and some overlap with B.
